subject: E-Commerce
title: Hyper-Local Commerce
description: A quick, practical guide to Hyper-Local Commerce.

hook.text: Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats deliver from local stores in 30 minutes. Global e-commerce is turning hyper-local.

buildup.text: Why wait 2 days for Amazon when the pharmacy 2 blocks away can deliver in 20 minutes via DoorDash?

discovery.text: DoorDash now delivers from convenience stores, pet shops, and hardware stores—not just restaurants.

twist.text: Hyper-local delivery costs $5-10 per order in fees. The convenience tax makes everyday items significantly more.

climax.text: The future may be both global and local: Amazon for variety, local apps for urgency. Different needs, different pipes.

punchline.text: 30-minute delivery from local stores. Global e-commerce is going hyper-local.

quiz.question: How is e-commerce becoming hyper-local?
options: Delivery apps now fulfill from nearby local stores in 30 minutes instead of distant warehouses
